notes:
JAPANESE EGG DISHES:
{出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご} is a Kyoto-style Japanese omelet made with dashi broth, resulting in a soft, moist texture.

DIFFERENCE FROM {卵焼|たまごや}き:
- {出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}: Contains dashi, softer and juicier, more common in Kansai
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧: Often sweeter, drier, more common in Kanto

COOKING TIPS:
- Uses ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (dashi broth) mixed with eggs
- Cooked in a rectangular pan (⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧{器|き})
- Requires technique to roll layers while cooking

SERVING:
- Common in ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧ (izakaya)
- Part of traditional Japanese breakfast
- Often served with ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧ (grated daikon)
